item.name: Retrieve all certificates from the domain to the root Certificate Authority (CA) of a domain.

request.name: Retrieve all certificates from the domain to the root Certificate Authority (CA) of a domain.

description.content:
Retrieve the complete SSL certificate chain from root Certificate Authority (CA) to end-user certificate.
This endpoint provides comprehensive information about each certificate in the chain.

Set to true to get the raw openSSL response for each certificate in the chain
